name: The majority voted against [Australian Greens amendments](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2026-03-31.216.1), which means they were unsuccessful. These amendments related to the following: a 6‑month sunset clause; materials, goods or things must be of a kind prescribed by regulations; and excluding things with military use. While Tasmanian Senator [Tammy Tyrrell](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/tasmania/tammy_tyrrell) (Independent) voted "yes" in this vote, she subsequently noted that she opposed the amendments on [sheet 3757](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/display.w3p;query=Id%3A%22legislation%2Famend%2Fr7472_amend_e95be31c-78e0-49f2-a5f8-16e754656f47%22;rec=0), which related to excluding things with military use. ### Amendment text See [openaustralia.org.au](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2026-03-31.216.1) for the amendment text.
